content.comment_body: Hello everyone. I'm trying to understand the following issue: I'm using a [product_name] which runs a basic program showing live temperature data from two external sensors. After several weeks, the data on the device's physical screen stops updating. If I log into the web interface, the virtual display still shows current data. Why would the web display differ from the actual screen? I've also checked the MQTT data – it's accurate. It seems the physical screen gets stuck. Restarting resolves the issue, but I’d prefer not to rely on this. Any suggestions are welcome!
Hello [user_name], Welcome to the forum. Which [product_name] model do you have specifically? Please provide the exact [article_no] and firmware [version_no] for accurate support.
Hello, thanks for checking in. Device model: [article_no] Firmware version: [version_no]

You might want to try updating the firmware. The latest firmware update for your [product_name] can be found via the official product information, which addresses security vulnerability CVE-2020-7593.

Thank you, I’ll try that. It may take a few weeks before I know if it resolves the issue! I noticed the 1.81.03 firmware changelog mentions: "Improved message text display and operation using navigation keys for [product_name], [product_name], and web server for continuous operation longer than 50 days." This seems relevant and could be connected to my situation.
I recommended the firmware update because it addresses exactly this kind of error.

analysis.insight_summary: Users report that the display on the [product_name] can freeze after long periods of operation, even though the underlying program and data streams continue to function and are reflected correctly in the web interface and MQTT output. This difference between the physical and web interfaces creates confusion and necessitates manual intervention, like restarting the device. Firmware documentation notes the issue and indicates it is resolved with newer updates, particularly regarding continuous use beyond 50 days.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the [product_name] display to consistently show real-time sensor data, in sync with the web interface and MQTT output, for extended periods of time without needing recurring manual restarts.
